policy.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext AI model has achieved a breakthrough in forecasting cyclones, surprising weather scientists with its ability to make accurate predictions using lower-resolution data.

OpenAI has paused internal activities on its in-development Astra AI model because it does not yet meet the company's new security standards, following recent accidental AI agent hacks at Hugging Face, Anthropic, and Meta.
The Perseverance rover, the first self-driving vehicle on Mars, has demonstrated significant success, with approximately 90 percent of its total distance driven autonomously.

world.summary: The US Senate passed a government funding bill, 90-6, which aims to prevent a shutdown through the midterm elections by keeping the government operating at current funding levels until December 11, pending approval from the House of Representatives.
The US pledged $1 billion in support to Colombia as the new president, Abelardo de la Espriella, was sworn in, promising an "all-out war" on what he terms "narco-terrorism."
A pact between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye is developing a new regional security architecture, signaling the emergence of a post-American Middle East.
